displayIdentity.body: Adam and Christ frame trespass and life. Therefore, as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin, so death passed to all men because all sinned. that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
